featured_reviews.name: Jiten Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all a BIG thank you to Sachin ji and Pramila ben. Amazing people and amazing work they do. KUDOS to them.
What can i say... "Ghar ka Khana, Maa ke haat ka khana, Hygiene khana," All this at a good price and on time delivery everyday.
I started this service 2 weeks back i.e. from 4th April22. Original plan was to have it for a few days as there was a medical emergency at my place, but i continue till date. Further more i am sure, I will continue.
While there are a few negative reviews on Google, my initial hesitancy was there. But when i understood the pressure of delivery that the team has, it is for us to listen to them and understand their problem. Their plate is all full and they try to accommodate any new request as they already are serving their key old customers [especially old age people].
While Sachin ji feels rude to us on the call, but if you try to understand his delivery schedule, i am sure you will give up. [I too did, Empathy is required to understand him]
I too had to initially adjust, but now everything has smoothened up and now my spose, child and me are all GAGA for the food that we get. I would rate delivery/service/food quality all 10 out of 5.Thank you Sachin & Pramila ben.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Gurnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was wanting to try this home made meal from a long time and finally could manage to try it last night. The team is very courteous and eager to ensure a pleasant food experience. The meal which is priced quite economically at 120rs inclusive of home delivery charges comes in plastic containers and rotis in safe and nice packing. The meal had a portion of white rice which were of good quality which is hard to find such tiffin services, a container portion of dal which was plain with mild tadka and just the kind you would expect at home that suits all taste buds, rotis were typical sindhi style that is very soft with a touch of oil and last was the paneer capsicum which was mildly dry and had onion in it too.

Overall the meal was pretty good and so was the service. I will be giving it a few more try soon again to experience more items.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Thiagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across Sunita's Tiffin Services while looking for a good, home cooked meal delivery service that can deliver meals in and around Chembur, Kurla East, Chunabhatti. I was looking for home cooked meals for dinner as I wanted to avoid the hassle of making meals post 9 P.M. or eating random food from hotels.

I've been availing their services since June 2024 and am a delighted customer.

They have meals labelled regular (large portions) and mini (standard portions). The meals come with a Sabzi, a Dal, Rotis and Rice. You can get extra Rotis instead of the rice or vice versa as they are open to customising. Their food is home made, light on the stomach, and tastes wonderful. The team juggles their sabzis and dals everyday offering the consumer lots of variety.

They deliver lunch and dinner at the doorstep with the help of a great group of delivery personnel.

I can't praise them enough. Great food, great service and a delight!

featured_reviews.name: Samyak Dhoke

The food is tasty, hygienic, and always delivered on time. They even update the menu on WhatsApp every day, which makes it super convenient. Whoever handles communication on WhatsApp is very polite, kind, and respectful, which makes the service even better.

As someone new to the city, their food really felt like comfort food, simple, homely, and wholesome. After coming back from a long 11–8 office day, having VT’s food with Netflix felt like the best combo. For the price we pay, they genuinely provide the best quality food possible.

My experience with VT Foods has been amazing, and I’d definitely recommend them to anyone looking for home-style meals in Mumbai. Thank you, VT Foods, for making my stay here so much better!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much, Samyak, for taking the time to write such a detailed and heartfelt review. Your words truly mean a lot to us. 🙏✨

We’re really happy to know that VT’s Foods could make your stay in Mumbai a little easier and more comfortable. Knowing that our meals gave you a homely, comforting experience after long internship hours makes our effort completely worth it.

Thank you for appreciating the hygiene, timely delivery, and our daily WhatsApp menu updates. We’re glad that our communication and support felt polite and helpful. we always try to make every customer feel valued and cared for.

Your line about enjoying VT’s food with Netflix after an 11–8 day genuinely made us smile. That’s exactly the feeling we aim to bring simple, wholesome, home-style meals that feel like a warm break in a busy day.

We’re grateful that you found the quality worth the price and that our service could be a small part of making your two months in Mumbai better. Your recommendation truly motivates us to keep improving and serving with the same honesty.

Thank you once again, Samyak, for choosing VT’s Foods and for such a beautiful review. Wishing you all the best in your final year and your career ahead! 🤍✨
